name: Adobe Spectrum 2

files.tokens/artboard-tokens.css: the block every .dc.html artboard embeds verbatim
files.tokens/layout.css: spacing, radii, border widths, control heights, icon sizes
files.tokens/typography.css: families, weights, line heights, size ramp, role sizes
files.tokens/tokens.json: flat map the checker measures against
files.components/control-geometry.json: control geometry read out of the S2 source

notes: Tokens only — no React bundle or component CSS. Artboards are self-contained Design Components with no network egress, so the system is embedded and verified rather than linked.
